newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Burswood Property units top turnover.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Burswood Property units top turnover.

text.p: Units in Burswood Property Trust, the owner and operator of the Burswood casino in Perth, topped turnover early on Wednesday in active pre-opening trade.
By 10.20 a.m. (2320 GMT), Burswood units were two cents lower at A$1.55 with 39.5 million units or about 9.8 percent of the issued capital traded.
Brokers said the bulk of the trade was in a number of large lines crossed through BZW Australia prior to the official opening at a price of A$1.50 per unit.
While early speculation centred on a Japanese investor cutting its stake, a Burswood spokesman said it was not currently aware of the identity of the seller.
"We are not aware (of the seller's identity) at this stage," said a company spokesman.
By 12.20 p.m. (0120 GMT), Burswood units were two cents lower at A$1.55 on turnover of 40.26 million shares.
